cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
import os
os.environ.setdefault('RCB_MUJOCO_GL','egl')
import numpy as np
import mujoco as mj
import rcb_aloha as ra
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.s=ra.Session('/app/instance.json')
        self.m=self.s.model
        self.fk=mj.MjData(self.m)
        self.fk.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        self.jids=[np.array([self.m.joint(a+'/'+j).id for j in ['waist','shoulder','elbow','forearm_roll','wrist_angle','wrist_rotate']]) for a in ['left','right']]
        self.qids=[self.m.jnt_qposadr[x] for x in self.jids]
        self.vids=[self.m.jnt_dofadr[x] for x in self.jids]
        self.sids=[self.m.site(a+'/gripper').id for a in ['left','right']]
        self.refs=[self.s.data.qpos[q].copy() for q in self.qids]
        self.grips=[.037,.037]
        self.ints=[np.zeros(6),np.zeros(6)]
        self.kp=self.m.actuator_gainprm[self.s._act,0]
        self.s.record_start()
    def pose(self,arm):
        return self.s.data.site_xpos[self.sids[arm]].copy(),self.s.data.site_xmat[self.sids[arm]].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def ik(self,arm,pos,rot,guess=None):
        qids=self.qids[arm]
        if guess is None:guess=self.refs[arm]
        self.fk.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        def fun(q):
            self.fk.qpos[qids]=q
            mj.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.fk)
            mat=self.fk.site_xmat[self.sids[arm]].reshape(3,3)
            return np.r_[self.fk.site_xpos[self.sids[arm]]-pos,.15*Rotation.from_matrix(rot@mat.T).as_rotvec()]
        lo=self.m.jnt_range[self.jids[arm],0]+1e-5
        hi=self.m.jnt_range[self.jids[arm],1]-1e-5
        opt=least_squares(fun,np.clip(guess,lo,hi),bounds=(lo,hi),xtol=1e-11,ftol=1e-11,gtol=1e-11,max_nfev=120)
        err=np.linalg.norm(fun(opt.x))
        if err>.004:print('IK residual',arm,pos,err,opt.x,flush=True)
        return opt.x
    def tick(self):
        tg=self.s.targets.copy()
        for a in range(2):
            off=a*7
            q=self.s.data.qpos[self.qids[a]]
            err=self.refs[a]-q
            self.ints[a]=np.clip(self.ints[a]+err*.02,-.04,.04)
            tg[off:off+6]=self.refs[a]+self.s.data.qfrc_bias[self.vids[a]]/self.kp[off:off+6]+.4*err+.5*self.ints[a]
            tg[off+6]=self.grips[a]
        return self.s.step(tg)
    def wait(self,n=100):
        for _ in range(n):self.tick()
    def joints(self,arm,q,n=150,settle=60):
        start=self.refs[arm].copy()
        for t in range(1,n+1):
            u=t/n;h=u*u*(3-2*u)
            self.refs[arm]=start+(q-start)*h
            self.tick()
        self.wait(settle)
    def move(self,arm,pos,rot=None,n=150,settle=60):
        if rot is None:rot=self.pose(arm)[1]
        q=self.ik(arm,np.array(pos),rot)
        self.joints(arm,q,n,settle)
    def status(self,label,render=False):
        print(label,'steps',self.s.steps,self.s.check(),'box',self.s.state()['box_pos'],'sites',[self.pose(a)[0] for a in range(2)],'q',[self.s.data.qpos[x] for x in self.qids],flush=True)
        print('box contacts',[(self.m.geom(c.geom1).name,self.m.geom(c.geom2).name,round(c.dist,5)) for c in self.s.data.contact[:self.s.data.ncon] if self.s._box_geom in [c.geom1,c.geom2]],flush=True)
        if render:Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+label+'.png')

LEFT=np.eye(3)
RIGHT=np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.])

def run():
    c=Controller();s=c.s
    box=s.state()['box_pos'].copy()
    c.move(0,box+[.005,0,.10],LEFT,n=150)
    c.status('above',True)
    c.move(0,box+[.005,0,.006],LEFT,n=150)
    c.status('grasp',True)
    c.grips[0]=.002;c.wait(160)
    c.status('closed',True)
    p=c.pose(0)[0];c.move(0,p+[0,0,.17],LEFT,n=180)
    c.status('lift',True)
    A=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(A,'/app/output/trial.npz')
    print('replay',s.replay(A),flush=True)
    if s._renderer:s._renderer.close()

if __name__=='__main__':run()
